entity.name: Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA)
entity.meta_description: The Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA) authorized the EHang EH216-S first urban pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East (Nov 2025). Law No. 10 of 2026 gives QCAA statutory licensing powers over unmanned aircraft. Distinct from MoT.
